module.purpose: Provides bookmark shape sizing, URL normalization, deterministic asset resolution, asynchronous metadata hydration, and bookmark creation for the tldraw editor.
module.summary: This module coordinates bookmark shapes with externally fetched bookmark assets. It derives stable asset identifiers from URLs, computes rendering heights from available metadata, creates visible placeholder shapes immediately, reuses cached assets when possible, and asynchronously hydrates missing metadata. Debounced URL-change handling limits repeated asset requests, while disposal, deletion, URL changes, and replaced assets are checked before applying asynchronous results.
module.businessContext: Supports users pasting or editing web links as visual bookmark cards. Failure leaves a usable URL-only bookmark, while incorrect synchronization can produce stale metadata, wrong geometry, or broken editor state.

units.name: getBookmarkHeight

detail.name: getBookmarkHeight
detail.signature: export function getBookmarkHeight(editor: Editor, assetId?: TLAssetId | null)
preconditions: editor provides getAsset(assetId) when a non-null assetId is supplied
postconditions: Returns a numeric bookmark height.
An asset with neither image nor title returns BOOKMARK_JUST_URL_HEIGHT.
An asset with a title but no image returns SHORT_BOOKMARK_HEIGHT.
invariants: The editor and asset lookup are not mutated.
The result depends only on the resolved asset's image and title properties and the default bookmark-height policy.
edgeCases: assetId is omitted or null: no asset is resolved and the standard bookmark height is returned.
The resolved asset is absent: the standard bookmark height is returned.
The resolved asset has no image and no title: BOOKMARK_JUST_URL_HEIGHT is returned.
The resolved asset has no image but has a title: SHORT_BOOKMARK_HEIGHT is returned.
detail.summary: Determines the rendered height for a bookmark based on the associated bookmark asset. Bookmarks without an asset or with an image use the standard bookmark height, while text-only assets use shorter height variants.

specTests.then: The standard bookmark height is returned.

detail.name: setBookmarkHeight
postconditions: Returns BOOKMARK_HEIGHT.
invariants: The returned height is the configured BOOKMARK_HEIGHT value.
detail.summary: Returns the configured bookmark height constant. The result is independent of any unobserved input state.

specTests.then: The function returns the BOOKMARK_HEIGHT constant without mutating state.

edgeCases: A valid URL is reduced to its human-readable host and path representation.
An invalid or malformed URL is returned unchanged.
detail.summary: Converts a URL string into a human-readable address, falling back to the original input when it cannot be parsed as a URL.

preconditions: editor is a valid Editor instance.
shape contains a URL in shape.props.url.
postconditions: The asset identifier is derived from the current URL.
If an asset for that URL already exists and differs from shape.props.assetId, the shape is updated to reference that asset.

An existing matching asset does not cause an unnecessary shape update.
edgeCases: When the URL's derived asset already exists and shape.props.assetId already matches it, no shape update is performed.
When the URL's derived asset already exists but shape.props.assetId differs, the shape is updated with the derived assetId.
When no asset exists for the derived identifier, the function follows the asset-creation branch.

May create or register the bookmark asset for the current URL through the no-existing-asset branch.
detail.summary: Ensures a bookmark shape uses the asset identified by the hash of its current URL, updating or creating the corresponding asset association as needed.

specTests.then: The editor updates that shape with props.assetId equal to the URL-derived asset ID.
The function does not issue a shape update for the asset ID.
